confirmed_bugs.summary: Selection memory hydration sekali per app lifetime; project switch tidak load memory proyek baru; persist menimpa file proyek aktif dengan snapshot lintas-proyek (kehilangan permanen + polusi)
Persist selection memory tanpa try/catch -> unhandled zone error berulang saat disk gagal; kontrak komentar (swallow+debugPrint) palsu
Tombol top-bar desktop 'Projects' selalu terintersep ke Novel workspace; arm 'novels' => AppRoutes.projects dead code
onCreateNovel (ProjectOverview) tidak invalidate storyExplorerProvider -> novel baru tak muncul di Explorer
_createFaction tidak reload _factions; faksi baru tak tampak di daftar Factions (ValueKey sama)
Guard requiresProject mobile memakai widget.projectId (null di /workspace) -> Characters/World salah push Projects meski session terbuka
Katalog gagal diperlakukan sama dengan loading; intent typed terstrand tanpa retry utk character/story/environment
Story creation 3 langkah non-transaksional (story->chapter->scene) di 2 call site; kegagalan meninggalkan story orphan, retry menduplikasi
getAllAssets() full-table per instance family armor/accessory/story + filter client-side
Dismiss dialog filter (null) menghapus filter seperti Reset eksplisit
Filter karakter saat assignments masih loading merender nol tile tanpa loading indicator
explorerAssetFocusProvider tidak pernah dibersihkan; highlight fokus bocor lintas proyek
ref.read setelah await dialog tanpa mounted guard (2 situs) -> StateError bila panel disposed
Genre matching substring tanpa word boundary ('live-action'->weapons, 'warehouse'->war)
Branch sync-restore creature unreachable; _CreatureGroup tanpa onFocused (berbeda dari EnvironmentGroup)
Error provider module-prefs senyap jatuh ke default tanpa retry (pola assignments tidak dicerminkan)
